➡️Emergency Advance Payments Modernization Act to speed up financial aid

➡️Addressing storm damage and shoreline protection in WRDA
@RepGarbarino @RepJudyChu @USRepKCastor @RepBrianFitz WHEN are we getting our SALT DEDUCTION back, Short Round?

Cancer patients are getting crushed by government failure. Just look at metastatic breast cancer. Patients who paid into the system for decades now face endless bureaucratic delays—begging D.C. bureaucrats for benefits they already earned while time runs out.

But 250 members of Congress backed the Metastatic Breast Cancer Access to Care Act. That's what accountability looks like. No more waiting periods. No more paperwork maze. Just direct access to care for patients fighting for their lives.

The whole broken system needs immediate reform. Real change means cutting every bit of red tape between patients and treatment. When someone's battling stage 4 cancer, they shouldn't have to battle bureaucrats too.

Getting care shouldn't require a permission slip from Washington. For metastatic breast cancer patients, it's the difference between treatment today or tragedy tomorrow.

In Congress, I’ve fought for legislation to ensure Long Island is better prepared for the future:

Community Flood Coverage Savings Act – To make flood insurance more affordable.
Emergency Advance Payments Modernization Act – To speed up disaster aid for families in need.
Water Resources Development Act (WRDA) – To address storm damage and strengthen shoreline protection.
